snapshot.name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd
snapshot.about: Larsen & Toubro Ltd is a multinational conglomerate which is primarily engaged in providing engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) solutions in key sectors such as Infrastructure, Hydrocarbon, Power, Process Industries and Defence, Information Technology and Financial Services in domestic and international markets. [1]

flags: Other income is 30% of PBT — core profit is lower than headline
latest_quarter.headline: Revenue +16% YoY, EBITDA +4%, PAT +27%, margin 11.2% (-1.3pp YoY)

business_mix.what_it_does: Larsen & Toubro Ltd is a multinational conglomerate engaged in infrastructure, energy, manufacturing, technology, and services, delivering complex technology-intensive projects, renewable energy transmission infrastructure, and digital solutions globally.

segments.name: Infrastructure and Utilities
segments.note: Previously Infrastructure Projects; accounts for approximately 45% of total order book.

segments.name: Energy - Conventional
segments.note: Previously Energy Projects; accounts for approximately 28% of total order book.

segments.name: Energy - Green
segments.note: Includes Renewables and Offshore Wind businesses; accounts for approximately 19% of total order book.

segments.name: Manufacturing and Products
segments.note: Previously Hi-Tech Manufacturing, includes Construction Equipment and Industrial Product Design.

segments.name: Realty
segments.note: Classified as a separate reportable segment.

narrative_vs_numbers.management_says: Expects margins to improve in coming quarters.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_say: Operating margin percentage declined from 12% in Jun 2026 to 11% in Sep 2026.

promises.credibility: Management frequently provides forward-looking operational and financial targets, but many remain pending or untestable solely through reported quarterly income statement figures.

bull: Revenue grew by 16% YoY in the latest quarter Sep 2026, matching its 3y and 5y CAGR of 16%.
The 5-yr cumulative CFO is 1.15x PAT with ₹86,099 Cr versus ₹75,124 Cr.
The 5-yr free cash flow reached ₹67,047 Cr, staying positive in 0 of 5 years.
bear: Operating profit margin compressed to 13% compared to the 15% average of prior years.
The latest quarter Sep 2026 margin dropped by 1.3pp YoY to stand at 11.2%.
Debt to equity is 1.24, though it improved from 1.35 three periods ago.
